title: Bounded notification feed filtering and pagination

behavior.categoryFilter: The existing tenant-bound notification list supports All, RENDER, PUBLISH, AI, BILLING, APPROVAL and CONTENT selections; explicit category overrides retain the documented muted-category behavior.
behavior.boundedPagination: The panel requests take=20 with skip offsets and appends Load more pages in the server createdAt-desc order.
behavior.unreadSummary: The overall unread badge and read-all visibility come from the existing tenant- and role-scoped /notifications/summary endpoint, independently of the selected page.
behavior.refreshSafety: Filter changes, SSE notifications, 60-second polling, preference saves and refreshes use generation guards and preserve the current category.
behavior.preserved: Tenant/role scope, category muting defaults, read/unread actions, deep-link acknowledgment and existing migrations/providers remain unchanged.

localVerification.uiHarness: verify-local --ui-only --ui-spec=notifications.spec.ts failed closed before fixture startup because 127.0.0.1:6379 was occupied; no existing service was contacted.

limits: This increment changes only the in-app notification feed presentation and its regression coverage.
CI verifies owned fixtures and does not deploy.
Production/live-provider, external delivery, remote durability/RPO-RTO, deployed and full-master acceptance remain open.
